items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He might have been Kepard. He might have been Kepard, yeah. I'm trying to think. I can't remember.

ctx.x: And we were in Louisville for a month or five weeks. And we came back here. And then we, I think, I don't know if it's the exact time that Joe Oliver left and went to California. He left the old dream on that 35th Street. It was a colored dream on that 35th Street. And we went in there. And we stayed there. No, that was after we came from Milwaukee. From Milwaukee, we went to the, the, the dreamland. And then, I think, Joe Oliver and them, they came back to the Royal Gardens on 31st Street. And I think they…
Theo went back. He didn't want to be anything in the north.
